_comment: Confirmed v4 (Quickshell/Qt) from the running install (noctalia-shell-4.7.7). This JSON shape is correct for that version -- v5 (beta, no Qt) would need settings.toml instead, doesn't apply here.

templates._comment: THIS was the actual bug last time -- Noctalia defaults activeTemplates to an empty list, so wallpaper-driven colors were generated but never written into any app's config until you list the app here. Confirmed real template ids: kitty, niri, gtk3, gtk4, qt. For built-in templates like these, Noctalia writes the color file AND edits the app's own config to include it automatically -- no manual kitty.conf edit needed (that's only required for user-defined templates, which this isn't).
